_about: Copper 'one of the most-studied peptides' — contradicted by Mortazavi et al. 2024 (PMID 39963574, 'a surprising absence of clinical studies'). 'Over 50 published studies' checked on PubMed 2026-09-22: 174 GHK-Cu papers in total, 54 mention skin/topical/cosmetic use, 1 indexed clinical trial — so it is rewritten as a count of papers, mostly laboratory. Companion to copper-2026-09-22.json (product descriptions + clinical-research metafield). Tool: scripts/fix-claims.py.
